name: k2so-small-roboport-antifreeze
title: K2SO Small Roboport Antifreeze
author: MrSleeper
description: Small Factorio mod for Krastorio 2 Spaced Out that prevents the added small roboports from freezing. Useful to work around bots getting stuck in an infinite recharging loop when trying to build at the edge of big roboport range.
